name: Hellknight Retrieval Unit

items.name: Bola Barrage
items.text: The unit draws bolas and hurls them in a 15-foot cone, inflicting 3d6 nonlethal bludgeoning to creatures in the area (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). Any creature who critically fails its save is also knocked Prone and takes an additional 1d4 nonlethal bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Coordinated Subdual
items.text:
Requirements The retrieval unit's last action was a Whirling Onslaught that dealt damage to at least one creature of Medium size or smaller

---
Effect The unit attempts a single Athletics check to grapple, comparing the result to the Fortitude DC of each creature that they currently have Grabbed or Restrained or was damaged by the required Whirling Onslaught. It can target up to a maximum number of creatures equal to double the troop's current number of segments.

items.name: Identify Targets
items.text: The unit Seeks in a 30-foot burst within line of sight and Points Out up to three creatures in that area.

items.name: Pacify
items.text: The unit's Whirling Onslaught gains the nonlethal trait until the end of their next turn.

items.name: Whirling Onslaught
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The unit brutally pummels all enemies in a 5-foot emanation with their flails (DC 21 basic Reflex save save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8 bludgeoning damage

2 2d8+5 bludgeoning damage

3 2d8+10 bludgeoning damage

items.name: You're Coming with Us
items.text:
Trigger The unit Strides

Requirements The unit has one or more creatures Grabbed or Restrained

---
Effect Before moving any of its segments, the unit attempts a single Athletics check check against the Fortitude DC of all creatures it has grabbed or restrained. On a success, the creature is moved alongside the unit, moving the same distance and direction until the end of the unit's current turn. The unit can't move a total number of creatures greater than double its current number of segments.

text: These bands of Hellknight armigers sworn to the Order of the Chain are tasked with tracking down and apprehending those deemed criminals by House Thrune. They are trained to take their targets alive whenever possible but will employ lethal tactics when necessary.
